Name: Abigail Hair Dye Mod for ContentPatcher
Author: candidus42
Description:
Turned prettykiller's artwork into a ContentPatcher mod. Abigail dyes her hair as player suggested and responds accordingly.
To see this mod in action you have to talk to Abigail on any Sunday in Fall.

Original XNB mod is here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2104]Abigail Hair Dye Mod[/url]

Downloads.Description: Last version compatible with SDV 1.5 . Added a simple winter outfit.
